18.name: Brotherhood of Thieves
desc: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
objectives: Bring 12 Red Burlap Bandanas to Deputy Willem outside the Northshire Abbey.
details: Recently, a new group of thieves has been hanging around Northshire. They call themselves the Defias Brotherhood, and have been seen across the river to the east.
BI don't know what they're up to, but I'm sure it's not good! Bring me the bandanas they wear, and I'll reward you with a weapon.
completion: Back with some bandanas, I see. The Stormwind Army appreciates your help.

66.name: The Legend of Stalvan
desc: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
objectives: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
details: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
BAfter taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
BSeek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. I fear for us all.
completion: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....

90.name: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs
desc: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
objectives: Gather 10 Lean Wolf Flanks and Stormwind Seasoning Herbs and return to Chef Grual in Darkshire.
details: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite! Sure, I can make you some. But first I'll need the supplies. Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks as well as some Stormwind Seasoning Herbs. There are so many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem. For the herbs, seek out Felicia Gump in her canal district flower shop in Stormwind.
completion: Very nice work, $N! Enjoy the delicacy known as Seasoned Wolf Kabob!

114.name: The Escape
desc: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
objectives: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.
details: Take this invisibility liquor to young Maybell. It should last long enough for her to visit Tommy Joe.
completion: Oh...my! I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.
BThank you, $N. I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.
BAnd for you... please take this.

138.name: Captain Sander's Hidden Treasure
desc: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
objectives: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
details: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey! Now ye need to head due east. East up the bluffs, east to the road. Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road. There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
completion: Good work, treasure hunter!

162.name: Rise of the Silithid
desc: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
objectives: Take the Insect Analysis Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.
details: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing.

BI know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight. She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot! If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report. We'll need the help.
BLast I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.
completion: This report... we night elves know of the terror mentioned here. Fizzledowser was wise to send this, and you, to me.

BThese creatures will consume the Tanaris desert rapidly; they are nothing short of one of the greatest menaces we all will ever face. Familiarize yourself with this name, $n: silithid. The insects mentioned here are the silithid, and they are the tools of one of the greatest threats that both the Horde and Alliance face.
BIf only we were smart enough to see that before.

186.name: Tiger Mastery
desc: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
objectives: Ajeck Rouack of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers.
details: You are learning, $c. Let us test your skills with the mature cats now. Kill 10 Stranglethorn Tigers this time out.
completion: I am impressed, $c. You are progressing quite well.

210.name: Krazek's Cookery
desc: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
objectives: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
details: I do most of the cooking at the camp. And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay. The pot is a wonder! It saved me countless hours...until it broke!
BCan you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it? His name is Krazek.
completion: Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot! An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then. Let me see what's wrong with this one...
BAha! Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth. I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state!
BCan I fix it? Of course I can fix it!
BBut there's a price. Oh yes, there is always a price...

234.name: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery
desc: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
objectives: Deliver the letter to Grelin Whitebeard.
details: If I remember correctly, Grelin's camp is down the road to the southeast. No doubt he'll be eager to get his mail.
completion: Ahh, excellent. It's been a while since I received word from Ironforge.

258.name: A Hunter's Challenge
desc: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
objectives: Kill 5 Elder Mountain Boars and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 12 minutes.
details: $nath, is it? I can tell you're bursting with pride over completing the first test, hm? As I told you before, it's no large feat.
BYou should try your hand at boar hunting. Trust me, this is no Coldridge Valley boar hunt, so you'd best have a care with them. I'll give you just twelve minutes this time.
BDon't feel bad if you fail. I'd give you the shirt off my back if you succeeded!
BHave I ever related to you the story of how I received my famous scar? No? It was two years ago...
completion: You seem a bit worse for wear. No doubt the boars gave you some trouble, hm? No worries, I will be discreet about your struggle, I can imagine how hard it must be for you without the accusations of wagging tongues.
BOh! You managed to kill the boars? I... well, that is... that is to say, I'm not surprised! Any child could have--bet?
BWhat bet?

282.name: Senir's Observations
desc: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
objectives: Speak with Mountaineer Thalos.
details: I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?
BHmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.
BSpeak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.
BFollow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
completion: Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?
BAt least let me provide you with some advice and directions.

306.name: In Search of The Excavation Team
desc: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.
objectives: Return to Tarrel Rockweaver with Merrin's note.
details: It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.
BBefore we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.
BOrmer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.
BHere, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.
completion: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.

330.name: Patrol Schedules
desc: Speak with Corporal Sethman.
objectives: Speak with Corporal Sethman.
details: The note you gave me is signed with an "-M"...I don't know what that could mean.
BBut...the note also says this person shared patrol routes with Thorsen last week. So whoever shared patrol with Thorsen last week must be the traitor!
BGo to Corporal Sethman. He handles the patrol schedules and can tell you who was with Thorsen.
completion: Oh, yes I can check that for you. Let's see...last week it was...
B...why, it was Private Merle scheduled with Thorsen. They had the same patrol times all of last week.

354.name: Deaths in the Family
desc: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
objectives: Bring Gregor's Remains, Nissa's Remains and Thurman's Remains to Coleman Farthing in Brill.
details: The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades. I used to work their mills...before the Plague.
BWhen the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend. We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.
BThe Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath. And now they are minions of the Scourge!
BServe the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague. Serve me by bringing me their remains.
completion: Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think? When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them? I hope so. I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.
BIt is a foolish hope, I know. But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.

378.name: The Fury Runs Deep
desc: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
objectives: Motley Garmason wants Kam Deepfury's head brought to him at Dun Modr.
details: You have proven your loyalty to King Magni, $c. And your hatred for the Dark Iron scum is as great as my own.

BThere is a task I wish to complete myself but I am bound by honor to stay with Longbraid. But Roggo has gathered intelligence that proves Kam Deepfury was a conspirator in the attack on the Thandol Span. It was by Deepfury's planning that Longbraid lost his kin.
BDeepfury is being held for political reasons in the Stormwind Stockade. I want him dead, $N. For Longbraid! Bring me his head!
completion: So Kam Deepfury finally got to feel what it is like to be on the receiving end of Death? Good. Serves the cowardly Dark Iron scum right. You have done well, $C. The victims of the Thandol Span attack were but mere victims in a world torn with war and unrest. Their families will have the peace of knowing Deepfury got the punishment he deserved. Longbraid's brother's death has been avenged.

426.name: The Mills Overrun
desc: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
objectives: Gather 5 Notched Ribs and 3 Blackened Skulls, then return to Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
details: The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.
BThe orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.
BGo to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
BTo get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. When you see windmills, the battle will begin.
completion: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N. I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.

450.name: A Recipe For Death
desc: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Retrieve Apothecary Berard's journal from Pyrewood Village and take it to Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher.
details: You can be of further service to the Royal Apothecary Society, $N.

BWhen Arugal cast his wretched magic on the forest, he cursed one of our most promising members, Apothecary Berard. Now a mindless servant of Arugal, Berard is useless to us. But his findings might prove to be of worth. He was studying an ancient plague that killed off all the aquatic life in Lake Lordamere ages ago.
BRetrieve Berard's Journal from his study in the Pyrewood Village Inn and take it to Apothecary Renferrel.
completion: Apothecary Berard's journal! Why you are quite brave, $N. Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .

474.name: Defeat Nek'rosh
desc: Kill Chieftain Nek'rosh
Bring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.
objectives: Kill Chieftain Nek'rosh
BBring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.
details: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.
completion: Stoutly done, $N. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.
BYou are a $R of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.

498.name: The Rescue
desc: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
objectives: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.
details: Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

BWe went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.
BDurnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
completion: So the humans thought to turn our warriors into slaves, did they? We'll show them!
BIt would seem that they have taken Gol'dir, our leader, to another location. We must find him and rescue him. But we currently have no clue where he is...
BWhen we have a lead, I will be sure to tell you, $N.

522.name: Assassin's Contract
desc: Bring the Assassin's Contract to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
objectives: Bring the Assassin's Contract to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
details: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
completion: <Maleb inspects the contract.>
BThat explains the latest attack on Southshore. The Syndicate must be after me, just as they were the last magistrate!

546.name: Souvenirs of Death
desc: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.
objectives: Deathguard Samsa of Tarren Mill wants 30 Hillsbrad Human Skulls.
details: I hear you were enlisted by Darthalia to wage war on the humans of Hillsbrad. So jealous I am. . .
BWhile you're off having all the fun -- slaying humans, pillaging the town, terrorizing innocent people -- I am stuck standing guard here in Tarren Mill.

BPerhaps you'll take pity on an old Deathguard like myself? You see I am collecting human skulls. And you will be fighting humans for quite some time. Over the course of your long battle, bring me 30 skulls and I will make it worth your while.
completion: Precious skulls! So beautiful! I owe you as promised, $N!

570.name: Mok'thardin's Enchantment
desc: Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp wants 8 Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.
objectives: Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp wants 8 Shadowmaw Claws and a Pristine Tigress Fang.
details: The power of the jungle's magic must be realized and then harnessed by the Horde. My rituals have proven successful so far. I can cast very powerful enchantments. For you, brave $c, I shall make a special item indeed.
BBring to me some Shadowmaw Panther claws along with a Tigress fang. Not just any fang will do. It must be in pristine condition.
BThe beasts lurk throughout the jungle but you will find some close by, just across the river from Mizjah Ruins to the southeast.
completion: Your knowledge of the jungle is strong, $N. These specimens will be perfect. I will thank the spirits for sacrificing such fine beasts for the cause of the Horde.

594.name: Message in a Bottle
desc: Find the author of the message in a bottle.
objectives: Find the author of the message in a bottle.
details: The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:
BTo any that can aid me-
BPlease, my need for help is dire. A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.
BThe stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild Shore to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.
BI beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.
completion: Have you come to free me?

618.name: Facing Negolash
desc: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
Kill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
objectives: Bring 10 Barbecued Buzzard Wings and 5 bottles of Junglevine Wine to Captain Smotts' Lifeboat.
BKill Negolash, and bring Smotts' Cutlass to Captain Smotts in Stranglethorn.
details: Negolash is a hungry giant.

BWhen the giants destroyed our ship, Negolash went straight for my kitchen. He wasn't hungry for crew like the other giants. Negolash wanted wine...and my Barbecued Buzzard Wings. They're my specialty, and I had to go all the way to the Badlands for the recipe!

BIf you want to lure the giant, then get some wine and a heap of buzzard wings. Put them in our old lifeboat, southeast of here along the coast. When Negolash smells all that food, he'll come for sure!
completion: You got my cutlass from Negolash! I can't believe my fortune, $N! Meeting you has turned my luck to the better, make no mistake there!
BThank you! And if I ever get a new ship and you're looking to sail the seas, you would be my honored guest.

642.name: The Princess Trapped
desc: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.
objectives: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael, then bring them to the Iridescent Shards in Drywhisker Gorge.
details: My name is Myzrael. I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the Arathi Highlands. These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world.

BPlease help me. Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker Kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east. To power the cluster, you must gather Motes of Myzrael from the kobolds and apply them to it.
BI beg you, $N, aid me!
completion: Ah! You activated these shards. Already I feel more myself!
BBut alas, I am still far from free...

666.name: Sunken Treasure
desc: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
objectives: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
details: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.
BA little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!
BSo borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, $n, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.
BI'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
completion: Most superb, $N! The Captain will be very pleased! And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!

690.name: Malin's Request
desc: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
objectives: Find Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands.
details: Greetings, $N. You have the look of an adventurer about you, and I have a task that needs some tending to.
BArchmage Trelane, my original master, fled Stromgarde in the Arathi Highlands not too long ago, and he's asked me to help him in recovering some of the items he left behind.
BThe city fell under siege, and he attempted to defend the Tower of Arathor, but to no avail. I have agents in the Highlands already, but they've requested I send more aid. Are you interested?
completion: So, Malin sent ye? I don't care if Muradin rose up from the dead and whisked ye here on a dragon. I'm busy! Talk to Kryten if you need somethin'.

714.name: Gyro... What?
desc: Bring a Gyrochronatom to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring a Gyrochronatom to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
details: $N, you've done your job well beyond all standards.
B<Lotwil's obviously distracted by his work.>
BIf we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work.
BWhoops! Quick, grab the... yes, that. Thanks.
BNow I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom.
BIf you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.
completion: HA!
B<Lotwil grabs the gyrochronatom from you.>

BPerfect... just about done. No, really. I AM almost done now. This project is my top priority... at the moment. Let me pop this into place, and you can see for yourself what you've helped me create. It'll just take me a few more minutes... maybe... possibly longer. Well, maybe a lot longer. We'll see...

738.name: Find Agmond
desc: Find Agmond.
objectives: Find Agmond.
details: Prospector Agmond was in charge of our excavation sites in the Badlands, to the southwest. I say "was" because...well, I haven't heard from him in weeks. I need you to find Agmond so I can get his report.
BLast I heard Agmond was at the southernmost dig site in the Badlands--a tiny operation past the Angor Fortress. I'd start your search for him there.
completion: This skeleton must be the unfortunate remains of Agmond. His body is broken and battered, and his bones picked clean.

762.name: An Ambassador of Evil
desc: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
objectives: Kill Ambassador Infernus in Angor Fortress and bring proof of his death to Advisor Belgrum in Ironforge.
details: Ambassador Infernus was sent to Angor Fortress by Ragnaros himself to mind the Shadowforge seeking lost artifacts in Uldaman.
BIt has already meant tremendous casualties for our people, but it has obviously grown worse. I hesitate to guess how many artifacts they would be able to find and use against Ironforge.
BOur goal is simple, $c. Return to the Badlands and destroy Ambassador Infernus. Once the threat is eliminated, return to Advisor Belgrum with proof of your victory.
BIt is in your hands now.
completion: $N, your dedication to Ironforge and to the dwarven people cannot be refuted. I thank you for your help in this matter.
BI shall send word to Historian Karnik informing him that you have succeeded, and I shall also have aid sent to the Badlands as soon as possible to help recover the excavation site. Thank you again.
BBefore you go, there is one more thing I would ask of you in the name of King Bronzebeard.

786.name: Thwarting Kolkar Aggression
desc: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
objectives: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.
details: Lower your voice, $c. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag.
BLast night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar.
BWe mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans.
BLast I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
completion: The Horde would surely prevail if the Kolkar centaurs were to attack. But by preventing such an attack. we have spared our mighty warriors unnecessary bloodshed.
BAnd as sure as there is sand in the Tanaris desert, we know that there will be blood spilled before these trying times are through.
BYou have served your people well, $C.

834.name: Winds in the Desert
desc: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
objectives: Retrieve 5 Sacks of Supplies and return them to Rezlak near Orgrimmar.
details: I'm Rezlak, one of Gazlowe's boys. Boss sent me to help the orcs here in Durotar. Things'd been going good except for the caravans. Can't manage to keep them safe! Makes my job a little harder, you know?
BThe last shipment--they promised it'd get through!--was snatched by the Dustwind harpies of...where was it...Razorwind Canyon?
BI gotta have those supplies or I'll never get anything done! Follow the big canyon to the south, you'll find the ravine cut right into the west and east sides of the walls.
completion: Hey, now isn't that just the thing! You've got our supplies back for us. That's great. I'll be able to get back to work just as soon as I can find someone to haul these sacks for me.

858.name: Ignition
desc: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank.
objectives: Get the Ignition Key and bring it to Wizzlecrank.
details: I don't suppose Sputtervalve sent you? I'm in a bind here. I hopped in without realizing that I need a key to unlock the shredder's movement column. One of the other shredder operators asked me if everything was okay, and I panicked! Instead of telling him that I was missing my key, I told him there was some sort of mechanical problem.
BWe need to get out of here on the double! Go up to the control room at the top of the derrick, the supervisor should have a key for this shredder.
BHelp me out here!
completion: Yep, this looks like the right key. Let me just make sure I know how to work this thing...

BHmm... rotation control... This regulates speed and stability... fine arm movement control. Just look at this! I can't believe the Venture Company could design something this much better than ours. I've got to get this back to Ratchet!

882.name: Ishamuhale
desc: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
objectives: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.
details: Ishamuhale, Speartooth, is the fiercest sunscale raptor of the Barrens. He does not hunt for sport, nor for food. He hunts because hunting is his passion. He kills because it is his nature to kill.
BAnd you will learn of his nature, $N, for your path now follows the taloned tracks of Ishamuhale.
BBegin the hunt. Slay his favorite prey, a zhevra, then bring its carcass to the dead tree northwest of Ratchet. Ishamuhale will smell the carcass and be drawn to it.
BBe ready when he comes.
completion: This fang is merely a token, but what it represents is profound.
BIshamuhale's strength is in you, $N. May you use it with temperance. That is your burden.
BThat is your honor.

906.name: Betrayal from Within
desc: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring Lok's Skull to Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
details: Take Lok's head to Thork in the Crossroads, $r. <snort> He should know what has happened to my tribe without any words--ha, not that he would believe Mangletooth helped in <snort> such things. But I am sure he'll reward you for carrying out such a great deed. <snort>
BI will continue to bless you with Agamaggan's power for as long as I remain in this cage, $r. Until then, farewell.
completion: You found the Razormane leader and killed him yourself, $N? Amazing.
BI am without words, but that does not mean I am without thanks. The people of the Crossroads would do well to respect your strength.
BI must admit, I thought the leader of these raids on our supply lines was another quilboar. Thank you again, $N.

930.name: The Glowing Fruit
desc: Bring the glowing fruit to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
objectives: Bring the glowing fruit to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
details: Hanging from beneath its fronds of this glowing plant is a large, round fruit.
BDenalan would want to study this fruit, you are certain.
completion: You found this on Teldrassil? Intriguing... this fruit is exotic. Perhaps its seeds were brought here from far off. Perhaps even as far as Azeroth! And there's something about this fruit... it seems to have reacted very strangely with the soil of Teldrassil.
BThank you, $N. Now if you'll excuse me, I must study this further...

954.name: Bashal'Aran
desc: Find the source of the strange blue aura in the ruins of Bashal'Aran.
objectives: Find the source of the strange blue aura in the ruins of Bashal'Aran.
details: The ruins of Bashal'Aran to the east are overrun with demonic minions. The sprites and satyrs that have taken up residence in the area feed upon the magical energies of the area, their powers growing from continued exposure.

BEven with that, I have noticed that there is one shrine they will not approach. On the western side of the ruins, atop a small bluff, a strange blue aura permeates... There must be an explanation to the demons' reluctance.
BI would like you to investigate it.
completion: Ahh... To what could I possibly owe the exceedingly special honor of a $r such as yourself as company. Truly it says much of my current companions--with no offense to my hosts, the noble grells and satyrs--that your presence could be considered an improvement.
BBut please, do not let my uncivil tongue drive you from the place. It has indeed been many years, decades even, since I had civil accompaniment.

978.name: Moontouched Wildkin
desc: Collect 10 Moontouched Feathers from Winterspring, then return to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
objectives: Collect 10 Moontouched Feathers from Winterspring, then return to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.
details: Wildkin feathers from the Hinterlands appear to contain traces of magical qualities. These powers... they don't seem to be wielded by the creatures, it's more like they are simply inherent to the species -- part of their very essence.

BDuring my studies, I heard that a large population of wildkin inhabit the snowy lands of Winterspring. Could these creatures have the same powers? Please help me find an answer, $N. Go to Winterspring and gather feathers that have dropped to the ground, then return to me.
completion: Now I can compare the feathers... Let's see...

1002.name: Buzzbox 323
desc: Collect 6 Moonstalker Fangs and place them in Buzzbox 323.
objectives: Collect 6 Moonstalker Fangs and place them in Buzzbox 323.
details: The Buzzbox gives a burst of static as you hear Wizbang begin to speak.
B"The next Buzzbox is number 323. Ish north of Auberdine but... where's the ale? Wha? Oh, ish on the road sho ya shouldn't have trouble finding it near the bridge."
BWizbang mumbles something incoherent before you hear a loud gulping sound.
B"Thish one needs Moonstalker Fangs... 6 of 'em."
completion: The Buzzbox suddenly leaps into action, and you can hear the distinct sounds of teeth being ground to dust coming from within.
B"Sho, ya made it! Thatsh exshellent newsh... Sho... Why doncha move along? Oh! Unless you want another job!"

1026.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Find the Wooden Key and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
objectives: Find the Wooden Key and a piece of Dartol's Rod before returning to Shael'dryn at the moonwell.
details: I wish your tidings were better.
BRaene is correct, I know about Dartol's creation and the treants in the area--at least I did once. They've become corrupted now, their nature twisted.
BIf your goal is to find the next piece of the rod, then you'll have to find the key to open the chest it's in.
BThe wooden key is on one of the treants northeast of here, near Felwood. Once you have it, look for a small glade west of the road near the Felwood border... the chest should be hidden around there.
completion: I'm pleased to see you're back, $N.

1050.name: Mythology of the Titans
desc: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
objectives: Retrieve Mythology of the Titans from the Monastery and bring it to Librarian Mae Paledust in Ironforge.
details: The future is inevitable! We hurl ourselves towards it like falling raindrops to the Great Sea.
BBut perhaps, by studying the past, we can know what to expect and be better prepared for the unknown.

BBefore dire troubles fell upon Lordaeron, there was a bastion of knowledge tucked away in the Tirisfal Glades. It is rumored that a book called Mythology of the Titans was housed in the library of the old Monastery.
BBring it to me and perhaps together we can unlock the secrets of the past!
completion: You have rescued the sacred text!
BYour journey was long and acquiring the book was undoubtedly no easy task. But the dwarves of Ironforge stand to benefit from your success.
BThank you, $N, on behalf of the Explorers' League.

1074.name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
desc: Bring the Nitromirglyceronium back to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
objectives: Bring the Nitromirglyceronium back to Gaxim Rustfizzle in Stonetalon.
details: Here you go, stranger. Take heed with it though... it's volatile stuff.
BIf you're really a friend of Gaxim's, then tell him I say hello. If you're not, then have fun blowin' yerself up.
completion: Your task has been done flawlessly, $N.
BNG-5 is the unequivocal component in the recipe to ignite the wagons of dynamite.
BWhat? Yes, dynamite... wagons of it. It's the perfect distraction, I tell you... just wait and see.

1098.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
desc: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
objectives: Find the Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent.
details: In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence. It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!
BSo here is your task, $N. Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent. Find them, and if they require aid then give it.
BThis mission is as dangerous as is it critical, $N. Do not fail.
completion: Vincent's body lies broken, and still.
BAlthough Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.
BBut clutched in his hand is a small trinket...

1122.name: Report Back to Fizzlebub
desc: Bring the Fool's Stout report to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring the Fool's Stout report to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
details: That Fool's Stout worked great! I placed a bet on the next race, and... let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!
BThere's only one more task for you -- take this note back to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. He'll want to know of the successful test.
BAnd hopefully we can get more of that Fool's Stout for future races!
completion: It says here that the fool's stout was a success. That's good news!
BIf you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of Zanzil's Mixture.

1146.name: The Swarm Grows
desc: Deliver Belgrom's Sealed Note to Moktar Krin in Thousand Needles.
objectives: Deliver Belgrom's Sealed Note to Moktar Krin in Thousand Needles.
details: So, Korran has come to a similar conclusion about these insects--they seem to be a larger threat than we assumed.

BA few days ago a hunter returned to me from Thousand Needles nearly dead. He was with a raiding party sent to drive a dwarven excavation team out of the Shimmering Flats. During the attack, more of these insects erupted from a cave in the dig site and nearly killed the party.
BThey were led by Moktar Krin, and they've taken refuge on the border of the Shimmering Flats. Bring him this note.
completion: Don't mind the thundering echoes off the mountains' walls. The goblins and gnomes are out among the Flats racing one another in atrocities created by what they call science. There are bigger threats here in Thousand Needles, one of which killed more than half my war party.
BBut we remain here until we hear word from Belgrom in Orgrimmar. Until then, we hold our position here, and stay vigilant.

1170.name: The Brood of Onyxia
desc: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.
details: Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands?
BThis is most troubling. Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.
BNotify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.
completion: Why you tell me 'bout dragons? Me no like dragons. Me like it here. No dragons here.

1194.name: Rizzle's Schematics
desc: Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Bring the Sample of Indurium Ore to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
details: Rizzle's schematics describe the process of the refinement of indurium ore. From his scrawls, it is apparent that indurium ore is being obtained from the dwarven excavation site of Uldaman in the Badlands.
BMuch of the other notes relate to the heat resistant properties.
BUsed as a paperweight for the plans is a hunk of what appears to be unrefined indurium ore.
completion: Indurium? Interesting... If it is capable of resisting heat to the degree that you say, it would explain the performance increase the gnomes have displayed of late.
BThis sample you've brought to me will be invaluable, also. I will be able to perform some tests on this, but I'll need more for this to actually be of any use to us.

1218.name: Soothing Spices
desc: Bring 3 Soothing Spices to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Bring 3 Soothing Spices to "Swamp Eye" Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: I like cooking. Good swamp cooking. Fried green frog legs and the like.
BAnd for cooking, I need spice. Soothing spice. Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.
BDo you like stew?
completion: Ah, that's the spice! Now here's some swampy good stew.

1242.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Delivery Jorgen's Sealed Note to Elling Trias in Stormwind City.
objectives: Delivery Jorgen's Sealed Note to Elling Trias in Stormwind City.
details: Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will.
BI'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, $N: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut.
BYa can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
completion: I'm sorry, a letter for me? Well, I'll be... not often you get a delivery that's not a crate or barrel when all you do is work. Let's see what this is about.
B<Elling looks up at you while he opens the letter.>
BYou look a little tense, you okay, $N?

1266.name: The Missing Diplomat
desc: Find Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Find Private Hendel in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: Private Hendel is to the west of here. He's currently on guard duty protecting some of Theramore's infiltrators while they rest. They've been keeping tabs on the Horde base, Brackenwall, and looking for anything else that might threaten our borders.
BYou should have no problem finding him; just look for the tents along the road.
BI have another matter to attend to, but I shall catch up to you soon enough. You can always find me in the Lady Proudmoore's tower if you have any problems.
completion: Hello, citizen. This is a dangerous place to be wandering about. I wouldn't hang around too long if you value your life.

BIf you keep your questions short, I'll see if I can help you. Just keep your eyes open for any of those filthy ogres. Rumor has it there's a Horde base somewhere in the swamps. The infiltrators are doing what they can to find it, but the process has been slow going and we've had little progress.

1338.name: Stormpike's Order
desc: Bring Stormpike's Request to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring Stormpike's Request to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind.
details: There is a dwarven armorsmith whose work I admire greatly. His name is Furen Longbeard, and his skill is unmatched. I need a new shield, and I must have one of his!

BThe problem is... Furen is far to the south, in the dwarven district within Stormwind. In human lands! I can't imagine why he would live there, so far from Ironforge. The humans must pay him a king's ransom to keep him there!
BSo, if you want to travel and don't mind making some money, then will you send Furen my request for a shield?
completion: Ah, a request from one of the Stormpikes. That's a proud clan, full of quality dwarves. Rich ones, too.
BThank you, $N. I'll get to work on Mountaineer Stormpike's shield by the end of the day.

1362.name: The Kolkar of Desolace
desc: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
objectives: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
details: The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens. This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.
BBut as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat. It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.
BSpeak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur. He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.
completion: You are here on orders from Regthar? Then you are here to deal with the centaur. Good.
BI hope you're rested. I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.
BHave a seat, and listen.

1386.name: Assault on the Kolkar
desc: Maintain your reputation with the Magram. Kill 12 Kolkar Centaurs, 12 Kolkar Scouts and 6 Kolkar Maulers, then return to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
objectives: Maintain your reputation with the Magram. Kill 12 Kolkar Centaurs, 12 Kolkar Scouts and 6 Kolkar Maulers, then return to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
details: The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them! We laugh and we kill them! You kill them too. Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!
completion: The Kolkar fear you now! I hope you laughed when you killed them. It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.

1434.name: Befouled by Satyr
desc: Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
objectives: Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
details: A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.

BIt may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.
BTies have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
completion: You have done well, $c. You have shown honor and dedication.
BWhen our campaign in Desolace is done, the Warchief will know that you aided us in our actions here, and that you helped make his will manifest.
BI thank you.

1458.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
desc: Bring 10 Hatefury Claws, and 10 Hatefury Horns to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
objectives: Bring 10 Hatefury Claws, and 10 Hatefury Horns to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
details: One of my tasks out here involves picking up some reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos . Roetten seems to think it's easy coin in the bank since we're out here already. He doesn't really care that we're short-handed as is.
BThe first few items on his list should be easy enough to get, and it'd be a good chunk of coin for anyone helping me out.
BI need some horns and claws from the Hatefury satyr to the east of here. Bring 'em back to me and we'll get started on the rest of the list.
completion: Good good, $N. Not sure if these are of any good quality, but if Leftwitch wanted a specific type, he should have specified before sending the Reclaimers out here to begin with.
BWhat say you to getting on with the next item on his list?

1482.name: The Corrupter
desc: Bring an Oracle Crystal to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
objectives: Bring an Oracle Crystal to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
details: An oracle crystal would do nicely. They are crafted by the naga for their oracles to use.

BNorthwest of here, along the coast, is a vast coral reef that the naga have taken as their home when this close to the shore. You can find their oracles there. The Slitherblade are deadly and will not react kindly to your intrusions, so be careful and make haste.
BWhen you return, we shall see about finding this demon lord Azrethoc.
completion: A precious oracle crystal... flawless... beautiful. Indeed.
BWe shall begin immediately. Finding this demon lord should be our primary concern, and its slaying demands our utmost attention.
BTake a step back, $c, and let us see what this demon is, and where he may be found.

1506.name: Gan'rul's Summons
desc: Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak with Gan'rul Bloodeye in Orgrimmar.
details: You there. $n, right?
BI hope your schedule isn't busy, because Gan'rul wants to see you right away. You'll find him with the senior warlocks in the Cleft of Shadow.
BBased on my past dealings with Gan'rul, your summons is either a very good thing or a very bad thing.
completion: Good. I was afraid Ophek wouldn't reach you.
BIt is time that I further your warlock training. Any business you have currently will have to wait.
BI trust there will not be a problem with this?

1530.name: Call of Water
desc: Find Brine in Southern Barrens.
objectives: Find Brine in Southern Barrens.
details: If there is one lesson you must learn of water, it is this: water means rebirth.
BIts power flows, erodes, and makes clean all manner of things. You will find its ability to heal and replenish incomparable, but only when it is pure.
BWhen you understand that water, when polluted, can devastate all that it touches, you will appreciate how vital a resource it is.
BIf you wish the water sapta, find Brine deep in Southern Barrens. Her home is continually molested by the quilboar there.
completion: Yes?

BMmm. I have a feeling I know what you're going to ask me: what would possess someone to live out here in the deepest part of the Barrens, the threat of quilboar all around, and no protection? Well, we all have our reasons to justify why we act the way we do. The real question is, what brings a lowly $R to the deepest reaches of the Barrens to speak to a woman who obviously has no concern for her own well-being?
BI'm willing to bet we both know the answer to that.

1578.name: Supplying the Front
desc: Bring 6 Copper Axes and 6 Copper Chain Belts to Thorvald in the southern guard tower of Loch Modan.
objectives: Bring 6 Copper Axes and 6 Copper Chain Belts to Thorvald in the southern guard tower of Loch Modan.
details: The mountaineers of Loch Modan are fighting troggs, and having a busy time of it! They need constant supplies of new armor and weapons if we're ever to get a handle on those troggs.

BThat's why my colleague Thorvald is there, trying to keep the mountaineers in good gear. So if you were to make some copper axes and copper chain belts and bring them to Thorvald, he would be obliged. He might even share his knowledge with you.
BThorvald is in Loch Modan's southern guard tower.
completion: Ah, apologies! I didn't realize you were here to help resupply our troops. The stuff you made will be a big help!
BHere are plans for some armor. I hope you find them useful.

1650.name: The Tome of Valor
desc: Find Daphne Stilwell in Westfall.
objectives: Find Daphne Stilwell in Westfall.
details: Good! Your lack of hesitation is a sure sign that you are prepared and eager to test yourself. So be it.

BAt the very ends of Westfall's Longshore, a small house overlooks the ocean. There, a couple lives, the Stilwells. Jordan is an incredible smith, and he's gone to Ironforge to meet with the dwarves for a while. But this has left Daphne, his wife, alone and unprotected.
BReports suggest that the Defias have all but taken over the area, Daphne may need some protection from the villains. Go there.
completion: Hello, $N. I'm assuming by all that armor and weapon of yours, you're either here to try and take my land, or the Church finally sent someone to help protect me while my Jordan's gone.
B Well, let me introduce myself: I'm Daphne Stilwell. It's a pleasure.

BNow, you're not too late... I've only killed a half dozen of the scum since last sun up. They've been a little slow getting 'round the bend up there, but they probably saw you coming, which means they'll probably be here any minute.

1698.name: Yorus Barleybrew
desc: Speak with Yorus Barleybrew.
objectives: Speak with Yorus Barleybrew.
details: Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the Alliance. He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.
completion: Hah! So you heard of my challenge, did you?
BWell sit down and listen. Have a drink, and savor it... because it might be your last.

1818.name: Speak with Dillinger
desc: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
objectives: Speak with Deathguard Dillinger in Brill.
details: I was told Deathguard Dillinger has a job for someone like you. If you're willing to show your value to the Dark Lady's forces, then report to Dillinger immediately.
BDeathguard Dillinger's post is on the west end of Brill, near the graveyard.
completion: You're here for a mission? Good. I have an important one, and one that will test your skill in combat... and your resolve in the defense of the Forsaken.

1842.name: Satyr Hooves
desc: Bring 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves to Ula'elek at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
objectives: Bring 7 Uncloven Satyr Hooves to Ula'elek at Sen'jin Village in Durotar.
details: I can make you a pair of brutal gauntlets, and great magic will they hold. But first, you must collect this magic and bring it to me.

BThe satyrs dwell in northeastern Ashenvale because of the forest's power. They feed off its purity, leeching and corrupting. You can tell which satyrs have drawn the most of Ashenvale's magic by their swollen, uncloven hooves.
BThese hooves hold great power. I will need them for your gauntlets' crafting.
completion: Ah, you have them! Now, just as the Satyrs leeched the strength of Ashenvale, I will leech the power held within these hooves and harness it into my crafting...

1938.name: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic
desc: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic to High Sorcerer Andromath in Stormwind.
details: Long ago, three mages studied in this tower until one fell to the dark arts. He was urged to turn away from that evil magic, but he could not resist. And so he was banished.
BThe fallen mage's new domain is the tower of Ilgalar in Redridge, and he took with him a powerful book--Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.
BWe, the mages of Stormwind, would have that book returned. Enter the tower of Ilgalar, find the tome in his library, and bring it to me.
completion: I feared that Morganth had hidden the book elsewhere, or that he had found a way to open it and read its contents.
BIt is good to see that he did not, and that the seals we placed on Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic still hold.

1962.name: Spellfire Robes
completion: Here are your robes, $N. Wear them well.

2178.name: Easy Strider Living
desc: Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
objectives: Bring back 5 Strider Meat to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.
details: Do you smell that delicious aroma? It's my secret recipe, $N--fresh strider stew. Delicious!
BPerhaps you would be interested in learning the recipe?
BBefore I teach you the recipe, you will need to prove that you can handle the beasts.
BNow, I don't expect you to go out and tame one and ride it back to me, but if you can kill a few and bring back some of their succulent meat, I may be persuaded to show you the ways of strider stew.
completion: Fantastic! Try it and tell me what you think, $N!

2202.name: Uldaman Reagent Run
desc: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.
objectives: Bring 12 Magenta Fungus Caps to Jarkal Mossmeld in Kargath.
details: I've heard about a newly discovered plant called the magenta fungus caps. They grow in clusters at the Uldaman dig site and can be found in the early tunnels and deep within the less-explored areas. I want to study their potential use in alchemy, and that's where you come in.
BFind the magenta cap clusters and bring me a dozen caps. Be warned, the clusters may spew out poison spores if jostled.
BDo this for me, and I'll whip up a batch of one of my famous restorative elixirs for you!
completion: Well done $N, you've proven your worth once again! The caps will be an interesting study, you betcha.
BAnd now, as promised, enjoy a taste of one of my more potent restorative brews from my personal stock...
BIf you are a skilled alchemist, then perhaps we might have some additional business to conduct. Regardless, I thank you for your assistance!

2298.name: Kingly Shakedown
desc: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."
objectives: Travel to Stormwind and seek out Renzik "The Shiv."
details: So there we were, about to start plottin' out phase III when a couple o' Magni's blockheads come bargin' in here talkin' bout some kind o' heist and arresting some o' the Hidden Circle.
BWell nobody puts the iron on old Blackbeard! The argumentations got heavy and thick and somehow yer name weres blurted out!
BMe advice? Take the first Gryphon out o' Ironforge and get to Stormwind. Get yerself to Old Town and once there, talk to an old friend o' mine named Renzik "The Shiv."
completion: It's always good to have one of Hulfdan's rogues among our ranks!

2418.name: Power Stones
desc: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
objectives: Bring 8 Dentrium Power Stones and 8 An'Alleum Power Stones to Rigglefuzz in the Badlands.
details: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman. I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!
BAnyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.
BI want those stones for myself! Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
completion: That's great, you found some! Thanks a lot, $N. You're the most dependable $r I've met!
BI can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with. I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...

2586.name: Salt of the Scorpok
desc: Bring three Scorpok Pincers, two Vulture Gizzards, and one Blasted Boar Lung to Bloodmage Drazial.

2754.name: Horns of Frenzy
desc: Bring two Solid Iron Mauls, two Silvered Bronze Boots, and two Silvered Bronze Gauntlets to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring two Solid Iron Mauls, two Silvered Bronze Boots, and two Silvered Bronze Gauntlets to Orokk Omosh in Orgrimmar.
details: The final lesson Orokk teaches you, $N. To the sacred anvil and forge you return! Bring for Orokk two solid iron mauls, two silvered bronze boots, and two silvered bronze gauntlets.
BSee the fear in their eyes as you approach!$B
completion: Astounding! You have learned the way of the Omosh, $N!

2850.name: Wild Leather Helmet
desc: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: A Wild Leather helmet offers the wearer superior protection to the vital areas of the head without a sacrifice in comfort. As with all Wild Leather armor, the integrated wildvine yields a powerful but random enhancement to the frame of the helm. Leather wearers will definitely want this piece!
BFor this pattern, I will need two Nightscape tunics, two Nightscape headbands, and a wildvine. Complete this order and the pattern will be yours!
completion: This Nightscape equipment you have supplied fills the order perfectly, $N. I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.
BYou have definitely earned this pattern. I give it to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.

2874.name: Deliver to MacKinley
desc: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
details: Thanks again for your help, $N. Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.
completion: Hm, let's try this...
BI can't believe it! This stuff is... terrible! That's great!
BWell I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me. He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum. That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!

2922.name: Save Techbot's Brain!
desc: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
objectives: Bring Techbot's Memory Core to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge.
details: When our beloved city Gnomeregan fell, a rogue spark must have jolted my poor creation, Techbot. It once aided me and my associates with its countless gizmos and limitless store of information, but its positronic brain has polarized. Now it's negatronic... and Techbot's behaviors are reversed. It roams Gnomeregan in a frenzy!
BBut perhaps it can be salvaged. Perhaps, if you can retrieve Techbot's memory core and bring it to me, I can discover the cause of the polarization and fix my poor Techbot.
B
completion: Oh, this is wonderful! Thank you, $N! I'll get to work immediately!!
BPoor, poor Techbot... Don't feel bad. We'll get you fixed.
BNow, where did I put that plug for my hydro-jack swivel spanner...

2946.name: Seeing What Happens
desc: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
objectives: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
details: We want you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.

BThis sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. It might, however, do nothing. You might need to use the discs on something. Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.
BWhen you've found out what happens, return to Ironforge. We'll have a lot to analyze when you're done!
completion: As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.

B"Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."

2970.name: Doling Justice
desc: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.
objectives: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.
details: As she's already told you, Kindal and I will now take the fight to the Grimtotem. Together, we should still be able to pick off some of the tauren without much threat to ourselves, but we'd love some help if you're willing and able.

BYou've seen the camp below us, but there are more to the east. Using your own tactics, deal as much damage to the tauren as you can. We can all meet back here after they've felt the sting of Kindal's arrows and your own weapons.
completion: Kindal was right about you, $N--you do have a knack for this. You are a more seasoned adventurer than the both of us, and for that we thank you.

BThe Grimtotem clan is much more hostile than most tauren... I wonder if their own kind frowns upon their actions. I wouldn't be surprised. As you are probably aware, many races on Azeroth have ties to less kindly counterparts.
BBut that is a discussion for another day.

2994.name: Saving Sharpbeak
desc: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.
objectives: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.
details: We must save Sharpbeak!
BFight your way to the top of Jintha'Alor in the heart of Vilebranch territory, gain the key to Sharpbeak's cage from the vile Priestess Hexx, and then find and save Sharpbeak!
completion: Swiftwind and Keenclaw returned with their child moments ago, and are fussing over him like new parents. Seeing them together again is enough to give even this old dwarf mist in the eyes...
BWe cannot repay you enough for what you have done, $N. The gryphons of Aerie peak, and their riders, will sing your name for a long, long time.

3042.name: Troll Temper
desc: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.
details: The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can! It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well.
BZul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan. Good luck.
completion: Ah, this is very nice temper indeed! And so much of it! I'll be at work for days before I use it all!
BThank you, $N. Please, take this as payment.

3090.name: Tainted Parchment
desc: Read the Tainted Parchment and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Tainted Parchment and speak to Nartok inside the Den in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.

BI usually avoid dealing with warlocks if I can help it, but I think you should read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from your newly-appointed trainer Nartok. He would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: And now you've joined our ranks also. Don't misunderstand, $n. Just because you have access to power that many will be jealous of, it does not mean you will be accepted easily. Thrall allows our kind into Orgrimmar because we are still his fellow kin--he cannot turn his back on us, or we would become as pathetic as the humans who enslaved him. My point is: be careful. You can be powerful, but if you are foolish, then you are as good dead.
BIf you need training in spells then return to me.

3114.name: Glyphic Memorandum
desc: Read the Glyphic Memorandum and speak to Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.
objectives: Read the Glyphic Memorandum and speak to Marryk Nurribit inside Anvilmar above Coldridge Valley.
details: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the mage trainer Marryk. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
completion: Oh, yeah! Arcane Arts... of course.

BHere's what you need to know, $N: Don't get into too much trouble. Save some coin to buy me an ale... or any spells ya might want. And stay the heck away from Gnomeregan. Other than that, have a good day! I'll be here if you need me or want to train... or whatever.

3378.name: Prayer to Elune
desc: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.
objectives: Find the Prayer to Elune and take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus.$B
details: Will you assist me, mortal? Will you find the prayer to Elune?
BAs I stated, the prayer was etched onto a golden tablet. One of these idol worshipping scoundrels must have it on their person.

BIf you do recover my prayer, take it to Astarii Starseeker in Darnassus. It matters little that my faith has been rekindled after the countless malevolent actions that I have taken against this world and its inhabitants, but my prayer must be heard. Absolution is the last thing I expect.
completion: Elune smiles upon you this eve, $N. You have returned a lost soul to her. Please accept this as a token of our gratitude.

3402.name: The Undermarket
desc: Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Speak with Vizzklick in Gadgetzan.$B
details: I want you to personally deliver the news of Kovic's defeat to Vizzklick in Gadgetzan. He will be so happy to hear that Kovic is dead that I'm certain he'll give you some grand reward.
completion: Kovic slain??! This is a glorious day, $N! For years that scoundrel has been running shady undermarket trades, undercutting honest, hard working traders all over the world.
BYou deserve a fine reward for this accomplishment! And a fine reward you shall have!
B

3450.name: An Easy Pickup
desc: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Xiggs Fuselighter in Ironforge.
details: I want the rubbings delivered to my tower, but there's no need to have you go all the way there. I'll just have them air-lifted out of Azshara.

BXiggs Fuselighter owes me a favor or two and will be in the area soon--he's signed on to patrol the coast. Speak to him before you leave. He can give you a flare gun to signal him with. When you have the rubbings, just head to wherever he tells you and then give them to him so he can get them to my tower safely. He should be in the hangar in the Military Ward.
completion: What can I do for you, $N? Kinda busy at the moment preparing my ship for a long trip. I just came over to see some of the tank pilots--I need some wendigo manes to line my cockpit and they usually have extra.
BI can give you a minute if you're brief... one of the boys just took off to Steelgrill's Depot to see if the pilots down there have extra manes for me.

3522.name: Iverron's Antidote
desc: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.
objectives: Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.
details: The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.
BThere is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.
BSpeed be with you, $N.
completion: What is this, $N?
BOh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!
B<Iverron drinks the antidote>
BI'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

BI am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...

3570.name: Seeping Corruption
completion: I never dreamed the elixir would take hold that quickly. Thank you, $n. I will get to work on the rest of these samples right away. I'm sure they'll be usable by the Lady Sylvanas and the Forsaken soon enough.

3642.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
desc: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.
objectives: If you agree to become a Gnome Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Oglethrope Obnoticus in Booty bay.
details: Gnome engineering is about engineering theory shaped to serve our needs! Our schemata allow us to make devices that control the world around us; the manual you read covered this.
BThe manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a gnome engineer, that's that. There is no access to goblin engineering at all.
BIf you still want to become a gnome engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, $N.
completion: Welcome aboard, $N! You soon will have access to the most advanced engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

BNow that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your gnome-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your gnome engineering talents!

3762.name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
desc: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
details: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.

BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.
BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
completion: Greetings, $C; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research. There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous. Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.

3786.name: Morrowgrain Research
desc: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
BBring 10 Morrowgrain to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
details: Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with. You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds. Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.
BWhen you have enough morrowgrain, bring them to me here on Elder Rise. Please don't bother the Arch Druid; he'll be very busy with the research, as well as the multitude of concerns he has!
completion: Well done $N, I will be sure to give these to the Arch Druid himself when he has need of them. Meanwhile, please accept this as a token of the Cenarion Circle's appreciation.
BOur need for morrowgrain, for now, is constant; if you wish to continue aiding us, then please return when you have cultivated more of it.

3882.name: Roll the Bones
desc: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Bring 8 Dinosaur Bones to Spark Nilminer in Un'Goro Crater.
details: You'd think that being chief digger for Marshal Expeditions means I like digging. There might be worse things to do in this world... but none really leap to mind.

BWe were supposed to be digging in Terror Run - FANTASTIC name by the way - for dead stegodons and diemetradons. Well, there are plenty of live ones there too! Wil and Hol are still all about studying this death trap, so we need those dinosaur bones. Between you and me though, bringing some from live ones will work out just as well.
completion: Excellent, these should do the trick. And now, if you'll permit me...
BTHANKS FOR DIGGING ALL OF THESE BONES OUT OF THE GROUND FOR US AND NOT HURTING THE NATIVE BEASTS IN ANY WAY.
BWhether you really did or didn't, I don't want to know. Let's keep it that way, shall we? Here - maybe this will keep your lips shut on the whole thing. Anything to get out of here alive, I say!

3906.name: Disharmony of Flame
desc: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.
objectives: Travel to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain and slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when you have completed this assignment.$B
details: The elders have felt a disturbance amongst the elements. The Dark Iron dwarves have summoned a foul spirit into our world that threatens to plague our lands with an eternal draught. This disharmony of flame must be investigated.
BTravel to Blackrock Mountain, through the Chasm of Flame, into the quarry. It is there that you shall find this lord of fire: Overmaster Pyron.
BEnd the disruption and return to me.
completion: This cannot be... it must not be. The destruction of Pyron has merely lifted a veil. Within the depths of Blackrock is a much more insidious source of corruption.
B

4002.name: The Eastern Kingdom
desc: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
objectives: Speak with Thrall if you are prepared to take on the mission he has planned.
details: You bring excellent information, $N.
BAs Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence.

BThe opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail!
BAre you prepared?
completion: There is no going back beyond this point, $N.

4122.name: Grark Lorkrub
desc: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

When you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.
objectives: Travel to the Burning Steppes and find Grark Lorkrub. You recall Lexlort mentioning that he was last seen in a massive Blackrock fortress.

BWhen you find Grark Lorkrub, use the Thorium Shackles to bind him and then lead him back through Blackrock Mountain to the Searing Gorge. Lexlort will have his men waiting on the other side to take Grark into custody.$B
details: I tracked him across the Searing Gorge, through the mountain, and into the Burning Steppes. That traitor was caught red-handed giving the Blackrock orcs vital information about our day to day operations. I'm speaking of Grark Lorkrub.
BHe now sits in the Burning Steppes, safely under their protection - or so he thinks.
BTake these shackles, $N. Find Grark, place the shackles on him and lead him through Blackrock Mountain. Do this and a tribute is yours.$B
completion: Can you not see the power we gain by joining the legion of Blackrock?

4146.name: Zapper Fuel
desc: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
objectives: Deliver the Unloaded Zapper and 5 samples of Atal'ai Haze to Larion in Marshal's Refuge.
details: You're in luck, $n! I've been working on some of my own experiments while Marvon's been gone, and one of them is a short range bug zapper. With just a few adjustments, it should be great for ridding yourself of those Bloodpetal pests.

BI can let you have one of my zapper prototypes, but you'll still need to collect the fuel. You can get the necessary Atal'ai haze that the zapper needs in the temple of Atal'Hakkar. The deep lurkers, murk worms, or oozes are the ones you'll need to get it from.
completion: So, Marvon wasn't around? Well, show me what you got, anyway.

4242.name: Abandoned Hope
desc: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
objectives: Give Marshal Maxwell the bad news.
details: Bolvar is a fool. I was gathering his precious 'proof' so that I could shove it down his throat.
BHe is a blind buffoon. Proof stands two feet away from him and he does not see.
BAs for my data, it's lost. Gone. Unrecoverable.
BShould I ever find Ironfoe and make it out of this labyrinth, my first stop will be Stormwind, to place my hammer in between that reptile's eyes.
BLeave me, $N.
completion: He's gone mad, apparently.
B<Maxwell lowers his head in mourning.>
BIt is unfortunate that a once proud and noble warrior would be turned into a blithering head case. I GUESS we've reached a dead end...
BI must reward you for your efforts thus far, $N.

4266.name: A Hero's Welcome
desc: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: $N, General Shandris Feathermoon would like to speak with you personally. No doubt she wants to thank you for your service to the Stronghold, but I do know that she also wants to talk to you about the insect creatures that you and Raschal faced in southern Feralas. The reports of those Zukk'ash insects are... frightening, to say the least.
BGeneral Feathermoon is waiting for you in the main compound.
completion: $N, I give you my warmest thanks for the aid you've given us. Your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds has warranted a reward worth a thousand times greater. Nevertheless, I hope you accept this on behalf of the entire Stronghold.
BNow, if I may... I'd like to ask for your aid one more time. In light of the discovery of the Zukk'ash hive here in Feralas, I think you're the best choice for this mission.

4290.name: The Fare of Lar'korwi
desc: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
objectives: Find the carcass of Lar'korwi's freshest kill and steal a Piece of Threshadon Carcass before returning to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
details: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind.
BLar'korwi killed him not far from this spot.
BIf you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it.
BReturn to me afterwards.
completion: This will do nicely, $N. It seems Lar'korwi eats well these days. Although, I wonder where he found a threshadon in this area. Odd.

BRegardless, I will hold onto this until you are ready for your confrontation with the beast. Do not worry for my safety--I am sure you've angered Lar'korwi enough that he will not kill me until after he's tasted your flesh.

4362.name: The Fate of the Kingdom
desc: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.
