objectives: Return to Blackrock Depths and rescue Princess Moira Bronzebeard from the evil clutches of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.$B
details: It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of Ironforge at his mercy.
BYou may be my last hope, $N. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira!
BThere is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him.
BAnd $N, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!
completion: <Princess Bronzebeard weeps over the loss of Emperor Dagran Thaurissan.>
BWhy???

4506.name: Corrupted Sabers
desc: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
Once you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
objectives: Take Winna's kitten to the corrupted moonwell, release it, then bring it back to Winna.
BOnce you have returned to Winna, click on the cat to release it to Winna.
details: This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, $N. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... somehow. These cats may prove useful...
BHere, $N. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moonwell in the Ruins of Constellas. Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results!
BReturn the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.
completion: Excellent!
BThe forsaken will resort to any means necessary to crush the alliance! The use of the corrupted water will surely prove useful in our future efforts...

4602.name: The Sparklematic 5200!
desc: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
objectives: Insert a Grime-Encrusted Item into the Sparklematic 5200, and be sure to have three silver coins to start the machine.
details: This contraption stands out amongst the gnomes holding out against the madness outside the room. A small plaque on the device reads "The Sparklematic 5200", followed by some text:

B"Grime and residue ruining your sparklies? The Sparklematic 5200 puts the shine back in shine-tastic! Insert the item you wish to clean and deposit three silver coins in the coin slot. Give the Sparklematic 5200 a moment for operation, and voila! Your valuables will emerge clean and shiny!"
completion: You insert the grime-encrusted item and three silver coins into the Sparklematic 5200. The machine surges to life in an almost frenzied attempt to purge the grime from the unknown item. Loud, violent churning sounds beat from the heart of the machine. The metal frame of the beast creaks and groans as it lurches from side to side...

4722.name: Beached Sea Turtle
desc: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
objectives: Take the Sea Turtle Remains to Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine.
details: You find a corpse of a sea turtle that had beached itself on the coast of Darkshore some time ago. It has been scavenged by the murlocs who have encamped themselves around the creature's remains. Still, there appear to be some suitable samples left on the creature's remains that Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine might be able to make use of.
completion: Another discovery for us to research - well done $N! These remains will be properly studied once they get to Darnassus. Please accept this small honorarium in exchange for the remains you have provided for our study.

4770.name: Homeward Bound
desc: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.
objectives: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.
details: Please help me, $c! I've been hiding here in Highperch for some time now and it's been days since I've seen a friendly face. I came here to study the wyvern and I think I got a little too close. After being chased away from one of the nests I got lost.
BI need to get back to Whitereach Post! Motega does not know that I am missing and will be furious to know that I ventured into Highperch by myself.
BWhitereach Post is just east of here... please take me there!
completion: Whats! If I knew that Pao'ka Swiftmountain was going to snoop around Highperch, I would have chained him to a totem! His father was reluctant allowing him to come with me to Thousand Needles. We came here to study the different creatures that inhabit these beautiful lands.
BI appreciate the help you have shown Pao'ka. I hope this covers any misfortunes this deed has cost you.

4842.name: Strange Sources
desc: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
objectives: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.
details: To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in Winterspring, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs...

BWell, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. You'll need to travel the length of Winterspring, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs.
BHave a look. I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.
completion: Yes, the demons there in Darkwhisper Gorge; I believe it is their presence that is affecting the land in this way. I am going to continue observing the hot springs here and see if I learn anything more.
BI'd wait until you are a bit stronger if you have plans of heading farther into Darkwhisper Gorge.

4866.name: Mother's Milk
desc: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
objectives: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.
details: It's probably one of the most potent poisons in the world, $r!
BI've overheard the Blackrock speaking about its lethality in my jaunts into the Spire. They call it 'Mother's Milk', named after Mother Smolderweb, the big nasty spider in the Skitterweb cave.
BNow here's what I need from you: A live sample of the Milk, flowing through YOUR veins. Just bringing me the gland won't be enough! Get her to poison you and come back to me!
BThen... I get to milk ya!
B<Rubs his hands together in anticipation.>
completion: This is gonna make the best ale yet!
BEh, what did you think I was gonna use this for? Poison or something??
BCrazy kids...

4962.name: Shard of a Felhound
desc: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
objectives: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.
details: So, you have chosen to capture the soul of a felhound, good.

BTake this ruby--with it, you will be able to capture the creature's soul. It works very similar to spells you already know: when the creature is close to dying, use the gem and it should do the rest of the work for you.
BI would suggest going to Desolace and trying your hand at any of the felhounds there. Those should do nicely.
BAfter you're successful, take both the captured spirit and your ruby to Menara.
completion: Ah, the spirit of a felhound. Well done, $N.
BWhen I have both the spirit and the cleansed orb, I will merge the two for you, but not until then.

4986.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
desc: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
objectives: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought. Seek one of the druids there for assistance.
details: The lifeless hand of the tauren druid clutches a surprisingly healthy looking oaken branch. Examining the branch reveals glyphs of a druidic nature carved into the bark.

BAs you grasp the branch, you notice it is warm to the touch, more than it should be. The image of the Teldrassil tree enters your mind - Darnassus specifically - and the words "Cenarion Circle" are on the tip of your tongue. It would appear that the suggestion of where to take the branch has been placed within it.
completion: This... this is quite strange. This druid - this tauren druid no less - entrusted you with a great deal of valuable information on the extent of the Scourge's plague. I am surprised a tauren would give a $R such information, and freely at that if what you say is true. We will make good use of this, I promise you. Perhaps the tauren have not fallen as far from Cenarius as Fandral would believe...
BErm, anyway, please - accept this as a token of thanks from the Cenarion Circle.

5058.name: Mrs. Dalson's Diary
completion: A diary with yellowing pages lies open to the last entry:

B"I don't know what's going to happen now that Harold's turned. It took everything out of me to drag him into the only place I could find that'd lock him up tight and hold him. I hid the key on me, and I pray it works...
BI hope I can get out of here, but I need money to do that. Our stuff's all in the cabinet I think... and now that I think about it, doesn't Harold keep the key on him?
BI'll rest on it, I'm dead tired now."

5082.name: Threat of the Winterfall
desc: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
objectives: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.
details: I came to Winterspring to investigate the Frostfire Hot Springs. I've noticed that the water seems to have ...strange qualities. I haven't yet been able to discover the source, and to tell you the truth, I've had some difficulty lately, due to the Winterfall furbolg.
BThey seem to be drawn to the springs, just as I am. They have become extremely protective of the water, and won't let me come near the two larger springs to the north of here.
BI'd like to continue my studies, so won't you help me?
completion: Thanks so much, $N! Now I can get back to work here.
BDid you find anything of interest at the Winterfall camp?

5154.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
desc: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
objectives: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.
details: To save Joseph Redpath, we must first discover his past. We can learn this in the Annals of Darrowshire, a book held in the city hall of Andorhal.
BBring me that book. We can then learn Joseph's fate, and with luck... change it!
completion: Well done, you found it!
BDid you read it? Is Joseph Redpath mentioned? If he is, then perhaps we can save him!

BAh. The Annals of Darrowshire tell a very unsettling tale. It says that during the battle, Joseph Redpath was corrupted and joined the ranks of the Scourge! He then betrayed the defenders of Darrowshire.
BThat is an ill fate. If we can, we should try to change that fate, don't you think?

5202.name: A Strange Red Key
desc: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.
objectives: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.
details: The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. Why would a member of the Shadow Council have such a thing? Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.
completion: The key, you've found it! Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!

5226.name: Return to Chillwind Point
desc: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring the Filled Gahrron's Withering Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.
details: You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle.
BWith the poison in hand, it is time to return to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp to complete the mission.
completion: Congratulations $N, you've unlocked the last cauldron for us! Alchemist Arbington will soon know what this cauldron requires as far as reagents needed for the mix.

BAs for you, I am sure that Commander Valorfist will want to thank you personally for the assistance you've given us. Without you, our struggle against the Scourge would have been nearly insurmountable. Thank you, hero!

5250.name: Starfall
desc: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
objectives: Find Starfall in Winterspring and speak with Wynd Nightchaser.
details: In Winterspring, to the north of Felwood, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore.
BMy studies here keep me so busy that I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring for some time. But there's no reason why you shouldn't travel there and study the ruins.
BWhile you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall and he knows a lot about the area.
BTell him that you are a student of mine...
completion: A student of Daryn Lightwind? Nice to meet you, $N.

5466.name: The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper
desc: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
objectives: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.
details: There is but one task remaining, $N. Confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair.
BUse the power of the keepsake against the beast - be unrelenting in your actions! Weather the blows that the flailing beast will surely bring down upon you. Do not give in to the pain!
BWhen the ritual is complete, Ras will be mortal once more. It is at that point that he must be slain. Strike him down and take his human head.
completion: Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, $N! You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.

5514.name: Mold Rhymes With...
desc: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
details: The goblin you will need to speak with is Krinkle Goodsteel. He peddles his skills to the highest bidder in Gadgetzan, within the Tanaris desert. He'll likely be the only one who can produce the mold we need, and his services won't come cheap. We now ask for you to dig deep by footing whatever fee he will charge.
BI'm an apothecary, not a banker. If I had gold lying around, I certainly wouldn't be here.
BI guess I said the quiet part out loud again. Oops.
BGadgetzan awaits you! Good luck!
completion: Dithers said you'd deliver the goods, and deliver you have! A deal is a deal; let me pack the fragments into the mold for you.
BDid Dithers imbue them already? Excellent... otherwise, it would have been a long trip back to the Bulwark for you.

5538.name: Mold Rhymes With...
desc: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Bring the Imbued Skeletal Fragments and 15 gold coins to Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan.
details: The goblin you will need to speak with is Krinkle Goodsteel. He peddles his skills to the highest bidder in Gadgetzan, within the Tanaris desert. He'll likely be the only one who can produce the mold we need, and his services won't come cheap. We now ask for you to dig deep by footing whatever fee he will charge.
BI'm an alchemist, not a banker. If I had gold lying around, I certainly wouldn't be here.
BI guess I said the quiet part out loud again. Oops.
BGadgetzan awaits you! Good luck!
completion: Arbington said you'd deliver the goods, and deliver you have! A deal is a deal; let me pack the fragments into the mold for you.$b$bDid Arbington imbue them already? Excellent... otherwise, it would have been a long trip back to the Chillwind Point for you.

5634.name: Desperate Prayer
desc: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind.
details: You're needed in Stormwind, $N. The High Priestess there, Laurena, says it's time for you to prove you're worthy of the next level of your training. Don't waste too much time finding your way there. You can find her in the Cathedral of Light in the center of the city. Give her my regards, and prove how worthy you are of such a calling. The Light be with you, $N.
completion: I'm glad you've arrived, $N. There are many things we will have to discuss, but more importantly is your training in the ways of the Light.
BThere are lessons all servants of the Light must learn. If you are ready, we'll begin discussing some of those now.

5658.name: Touch of Weakness
desc: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
details: You be far from home, $C. You be needed there, back in your city under the ground. Your mistress, the one you be callin' Aelthalyste be needin' you back there. Like my tribe, there things you must learn only from her. Don't be stayin' here too long. You should be headin' to the War Quarter as fast as a zeppelin can carry you.
completion: Ah, young $c, I am glad you have returned here. I would teach you a lesson you would do well to not forget. Are you prepared?

5730.name: Hidden Enemies
desc: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.
objectives: Speak to Thrall in Orgrimmar and tell him what you've learned.
details: You are one of my lieutenants! Prepare yourself, $c. I will call upon you soon.

BMy time spent on the Searing Blade may be all but wasted now, but that does not mean that the Shadow Council's schemes elsewhere must suffer. I will do what I can to minimize the damage here in Ragefire Chasm. In the meantime, I will have my agents in the Barrens and Ashenvale begin work on our newest agenda. Return to me soon.
completion: Ashenvale? Hmm, I had not heard of any presence of the Council or the Burning Blade in Ashenvale. My spies will investigate, $N. You have done well.
BFor now, rest, and keep yourself occupied with other tasks. I will call upon you again soon.
BLok-Tar Ogar!

5802.name: Fire Plume Forged
desc: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
Bring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Skeleton Key Mold and 2 Thorium Bars to the top of Fire Plume Ridge in Un'Goro Crater. Use the Skeleton Key Mold by the lava lake to forge the Unfinished Skeleton Key.
BBring the Unfinished Skeleton Key to Apothecary Dithers at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.
details: You need two bars of thorium and a powerfully hot heat source to forge the key stem. You're on your own for the thorium, but I can help with the heat.

BTo our west in Un'Goro Crater is Fire Plume Ridge - a simmering volcano. The lava lake up top is hot enough to fuse thorium and bone together. Your gold has bought you a mold that simply requires you to dip it in the lake up top; the lava will take care of the rest.
BThat's it on my end. To finish your key, you'll need to talk to Dithers again.
completion: We've got quite the costly skeleton key there, don't we $N? Still, it remains unfinished; the time has now come to put some focus behind our creation. To that end, you're going to have to face the ultimate foe we've been working towards facing in Andorhal... the being that runs the show within the ruined city walls.
BI'm speaking of Araj the Summoner - a lich, and one of the most powerful beings the Scourge calls as its own.

5922.name: Moonglade
desc: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
objectives: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
details: All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade, tauren and night elf alike. Keeper Remulos - Moonglade's guardian - keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. Now that you're learning the ways of the Claw, I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.
BAs for your first lesson, travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.
completion: "And so it begins. Father Cenarius. And so it begins."
BDendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.

B"The first perspective of nature you must adapt to is that of the bear. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but it is you that must embrace it and propagate it - now and forever!"

6042.name: Un-Life's Little Annoyances
desc: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.
objectives: Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.
details: You cannot take two steps off of this farm without running into one of those obnoxious bats. I want to be able to take the hounds out and slaughter Scourge without being accosted by any damned, dirty bats. Obviously, I have better things to do with my time than mindlessly kill bats day in and day out. You, however, do not.
BWhat? Your training? This is your training! Now get out of my sight and don't come back until you've killed a fair number of those winged demons. Don't disappoint me.
completion: It's incredible what a little anger and rage can get accomplished.

6066.name: The Hunter's Path
desc: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
objectives: Speak with Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village.
details: Hello, young hunter. You look to me like you are skilled enough to handle a beast and train it as your companion.
BYou must see Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. He can put you on the path to earning a pet of your own.
completion: Yes, I do believe you are ready...

6162.name: A Husband's Last Battle
desc: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
objectives: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka'Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.
details: My husband traveled Felwood for the honor of our clan, doing battle against the Shadow Council and other corrupt atrocities!
BAfter he escaped death numerous times, I received a letter from him saying that a druid asked him for help against a great befouled furbolg named Overlord Ror--the two were never heard from again.
BI want this Ror's clawed hand, $N. I want it to pay for leaving me a widow! I believe the creature is to the south... near the Ashenvale border.
completion: You bring honor to me for following through with your word. My husband died in battle--he would have been proud of that. But I could not rest until I knew that the creature that has forced me to live my life alone paid for what it had done.
BThank you again, $N.

6186.name: The Blightcaller Cometh
desc: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.
objectives: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.
details: <The blood appears to have completely drained from Flint's face.>
BNa... Nathanos did this? Nathanos is the Blightcaller?
BWhy? He was... was so noble - a ranger lord respected by all. The only human ever allowed to train under the high elves. Now a ruthless agent of the Forsaken?
BI... I am sorry to ask this of you, $N, but Highlord Fordragon must be informed of this turn of events at once. Please, return to Stormwind and deliver the news.
completion: No. It... NO! How? An agent of the Forsaken? The CHAMPION of the Banshee Queen???
B<Highlord Bolvar Fordragon slumps in defeat.>

6282.name: Harpies Threaten
desc: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
objectives: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
details: Tauren take pride as the protector of these lands. Undoubtedly you can guess why I am alarmed with the number of harpies that dwell here in Stonetalon.
BThe Bloodfuries are the source of the increasing number of harpies in Kalimdor; they encroach upon all likes of life preventing the innocent from leaving their boundaries.
BI need you to cull the harpies, $N!
completion: This is most excellent news! Tell me again how you cast fear into the cold hearts of those vile harpies. The Bloodfuries have been dealt a serious blow!

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
desc: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
objectives: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.
details: You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of Stormwind.
BWhat Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!
BDo not attempt to venture there alone, $N. You must amass an army! Gather your compatriots. To arms!
B
completion: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
desc: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.
objectives: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.
details: My Lady,

BYou know very well what it is we are offering. The opportunity for you to take the Barrens and the lands beyond is a great one. We simply want your aid in return. By aid we mean nothing more than your giving us the freedom to take action in the area.
BPlease, allow us to discuss this further. We have great power and are willing to share with those wise enough to join us. I will remain outside Razorfen Downs for the time being.
BBest Regards,$BAmbassador Malcin
completion: I recognize the insignia on this scroll, $N. You found this on that crone who reigns over Razorfen Kraul? Interesting.

BThe Scourge aren't content with one continent it seems. This Ambassador Malcin--the one who wrote the note--is one of the Scourge's plagued servants, a human diplomat to the kingdom of Lordaeron before things... changed.
BIf the Scourge are trying to gain a foothold in Kalimdor, then it is up to us to act.

6570.name: Emberstrife
desc: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.
objectives: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.$B
details: I have attuned this medallion with the magic necessary to create and maintain an illusion within the bounds of the den of Emberstrife.
BEmberstrife is an ancient drake; an old gatekeeper of Nefarian, burdened with the duty to test those dragonspawn that would ascend to the rank of elite guard to Onyxia.
BTravel to the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh and enter the lair of Emberstrife. Once there, put on the amulet and follow where your destiny may lead!$B
completion: Have we run so low on able soldiers that Nefarian is sending me whelps? You will never pass my tests, broodling.

6642.name: Favor Amongst the Brotherhood, Dark Iron Ore

6762.name: Rabine Saturna
desc: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
objectives: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
details: For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in Moonglade - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of Tanaris... and even further west of Un'Goro. You should find him in Nighthaven, the main village of Moonglade.
BWhile your work will no doubt be of tremendous benefit to us all, I advise you to tread gingerly. There are tensions between Darnassus and Moonglade... ones that may grow over the course of time.
completion: I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.

BI appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. I also know that Arch Druid of Darnassus expressed his displeasure to you in your lending us aid. Rest assured that it is for the greater good, and that you will be safe from any ill-conceived repercussions you may be the target of.
BYou are among friends here, $N.

7002.name: Ram Hide Harnesses
desc: null

7026.name: Ram Riding Harnesses
desc: null

7122.name: Capture a Mine
desc: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The mines in Alterac Valley hold more than just minerals. Both the Frostwolf and Stormpike have cached excess supplies in the Irondeep and Coldtooth mines... that's not a bad idea, if we could only maintain control of them!
BCapture a mine, then return to me. To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When you do that, the mine will be ours, and we'll send troops to protect it!
completion: You did it! Well done, $N!
BWhen we control a mine and have troops stationed there, it's much easier to gather minerals and supplies from it.

7170.name: Earned Reverence
details: I must know, $N. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
BYou have earned reverence among the Guard.
BPresent your insignia!
completion: When we first met, I would have never guessed that a hero was in the making. Carry on, soldier!

7362.name: Ally of the Tauren
desc: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.
Kill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.
objectives: You have been tasked with slaying opposing gnome players in Alterac Valley.
BKill a gnome and return to Ravak Grimtotem at Frostwolf Keep with a Tuft of Gnome Hair.
details: The Elder Crone has sent me to this warzone to research the other races. More specifically, I am to collect gnome samples. Magatha is primarily interested in their survivability. Aye, the gnomes - while pitifully weak and miniscule - exude great resilience both in and out of combat.
BFortunately for you, I am looking for ruffians to do Magatha's bidding. Return to me with tufts of gnome hair and you shall be known to the tauren as an ally.
completion: Aye, this is definitely gnome. Well done, $R, but there is more work to be done.

7386.name: Crystal Cluster
desc: null

7482.name: Elven Legends
desc: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
objectives: Search Dire Maul for Kariel Winthalus. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.
details: Several years ago, a lone elven master named Kariel Winthalus fled the devastation of his homeland with several ancient elven artifacts in tow.
BOur search for this lost master lead us from the ruins of Quel'Thalas, through the Burning Steppes, across the great expanses of the sea, to Feralas.
BWe suspect that the elf sought sanctuary in the halls of Eldre'Thalas (what is now known as Dire Maul).
BYou must find him, adventurer. Whether alive or dead, the knowledge he carried must be recovered!
completion: A shame... a tragedy. The items are lost you say? No trace of him, eh?

7506.name: The Emerald Dream...
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

7602.name: Flawless Fel Essence
desc: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.
objectives: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

BThe Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
BRecover the Flawless Fel Essences and return to Impsy in Felwood.
details: If you're going to reanimate Kroshius, you're going to need Fel fire. I can make Fel fire but it's going to require some components.
BYou need to bring me flawless Fel essences from three distinct regions of the world.
BThe Legashi Satyrs of Azshara will have the first essence type; the Jaedenar legionnaires of Jaedenar the second type and the felguard sentries of the Blasted Lands the third.
BBring me back one of each essence type and I will create the Fel fire, allowing you to reanimate Kroshius.
completion: Give me a minute and I'll combine the essences into Fel fire.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
desc: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.
details: A Bell of Dethmoora, named after the late warlock Dethmoora Darkeyes, is one of the three tools needed to create a Circle of Greater Summoning. When properly atuned with the Wheel and the Candle, these items conduct vast stores of arcane power.
BMy servant Gorzeeki can construct such a bell, but to do so he will need a large supply of elixirs of shadow power. Procure the elixirs from an alchemist and bring them to Gorzeeki.
completion: Very good! I hope these elixirs weren't too hard to get. Sometimes alchemists can be so miserly with their creations...
BI'll make the bell and keep it until you're ready for your ritual.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Well done, my boy.
B<Lorekeeper Lydros tears out a page from the book.>
BI am sure you can make use of this recipe.

7722.name: What the Flux?
desc: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.
objectives: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.$B
details: When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons.
BI want you to get our secret plans back, $N. I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.
completion: I hope you kicked his teeth in too, $N. Ragnaros knows, he deserved it.
BNow we can get down to business.

7794.name: A Donation of Mageweave
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7818.name: A Donation of Runecloth
completion: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.

BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!

7842.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
desc: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.
objectives: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
BGryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.
details: They say the Wildhammer and gryphon are as close to each other as troll and mate. Disgusting, but we be able to use this to our advantage, mon. We send them another message.
BKill all the gryphons you see in the Hinterlands, collect their feathers. From this we make the final message.
completion: Oh, mon, this gonna be good. One more step to go and Wildhammer see that they can't mess with troll!

7866.name: Outrider Basic Care Package
completion: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, $N. As a reward, please take this care package! Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

BAs you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase. Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

7938.name: Your Fortune Awaits You...
desc: Travel to the Deadmines in Westfall and seek out your fortune.

8058.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Armguards
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Vengeance is power. The Zandalar vindicator is such power. The tribe has many enemies. The vindicator exacts retribution on them. No crime against us is unpunished. The vindicator delivers this punishment. Our enemies fear our vengeance. They should. They forever will.
BBecome one of our vindicators. Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub. Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name. You will be rewarded.
completion: You have wrought much vengeance today. You have taken on the visage of the vindicator. You have brought the Blood God's minions to their knees.
BTake this. It will fuel your vengeance for the future. You are a friend to the Zandalar now.

8106.name: Kezan's Taint
completion: Accept this talisman, $c. Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies.

BKnow that around your neck you carry a piece of history. Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters.
BKezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but know that before the taint, it held greatness. Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.

8154.name: Arathi Basin Resources!
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
objectives: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
details: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
BThat is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
BThat is what I want from you, $N. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
completion: You got the resources! Great job! I'll send the resources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.
BThank you, $N. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.

8250.name: Magecraft
desc: Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.
objectives: Seek out Sanath Lim-yo and gain passage to see Archmage Xylem.
details: Archmage Xylem has been asking around lately... for someone of your experience.
BIf you wish to seek him out, you can find him in Azshara. His tower is built high atop the cliffs, and the only way up is a teleport spell invoked by his arrogant servant, Sanath Lim-yo.

BSanath makes camp below his master's tower. To find him, travel to where Azshara's main road forks at the entrance to the Ruins of Eldarath. From that spot, head directly north until you reach the cliffs.
completion: <Sanath sneers at you.>
BArchmage Xylem awaits your arrival.

8298.name: More Resource Crates
desc: Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.

8322.name: Rotten Eggs
desc: Place the Rotten Eggs in the main brew keg located inside the Southshore Inn.
objectives: Place the Rotten Eggs in the main brew keg located inside the Southshore Inn.
details: The humans of Southshore love their ale, and as such they prize the ale served at the Southshore Inn. With the chaos of Hallow's End now upon them, we can use it to ruin their latest batch of beverages for weeks - if not months to come!
BTake these rotten eggs and place them in the main brew keg inside the Southshore Inn. Your presence alone will cause strife, so be prepared to defend yourself!
BOnce you've given Southshore a taste they'll not soon forget, return to me here at the festival!
completion: The keg is filled with ale.
BHaving successfully fought your way inside the inn, you now place the eggs inside the keg. You can smell the foul odor permeating the air...

8370.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $N!
completion: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, $N.

8394.name: Claiming Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Marks of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
details: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.
BWhat we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.

BIf the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, $N.
completion: Good work, soldier! Keep it up and we'll have the Horde running all the way back to Orgrimmar.

8418.name: Forging the Mightstone
desc: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
objectives: Bring the voodoo feathers to Ashlam Valorfist.
details: Now we must combine the inert scourgestones and create a weapon to shatter the ranks of undead. This is no trivial task, $n. Only the trolls of the sunken temple carry the kind of rare magic able to turn the evil of something against itself.
BIn the temple, the trolls are known as Gasher, Mijan, Zolo, Hukku, Zul'lor, and Loro. Do not feel remorse for their corrupt souls... they are not without evil.
completion: This is excellent, $N. I would say I am surprised, but I knew without question that you wouldn't let us down.
BIt is my honor to bestow one of the Holy Mightstones to you. Use it well.

8442.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8466.name: Feathers for Grazle
desc: Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.

8514.name: The Alliance Needs More Medium Leather!
desc: Bring 10 medium leather to Private Porter at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8538.name: The Four Dukes
desc: Find a way to summon and slay the Duke of Cynders, the Duke of Fathoms, the Duke of Zephyrs and the Duke of Shards and report back to Commander Mar'alith in Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing V in order to complete this quest.

8562.name: Conqueror's Breastplate
desc: Bring the the Carapace of the Old God, 2 Idols of War, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Vethsera inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Honored reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8586.name: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops
desc: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.
objectives: Dirge Quikcleave in Gadgetzan wants you to bring him 20 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 20 Deeprock Salt.
details: My recipe is complete! What I need from you now is some rocket fuel and deeprock salt. I'll handle the spices and the meat you brought me will cover the rest.
BAfter you bring me what I asked for, the chicken will be ready to take back to Narain.
completion: It's ready! I present to you my greatest creation: Dirge's Kickin' Chimaerok Chops!

8610.name: The Horde Needs More Runecloth Bandages!
desc: Bring 20 Runecloth Bandages to Stoneguard Clayhoof at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

8634.name: Enigma Boots
desc: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj. This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.

8658.name: Striker's Leggings
desc: Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Bone Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8682.name: Skyseer the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8706.name: Hammer of the Gathering Storm
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Amber Idols, 5 Ivory Scarabs and 5 Bronze Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
BTake your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8730.name: Nefarius's Corruption
desc: Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard. Return the Red Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
objectives: Slay Nefarian and recover the Red Scepter Shard. Return the Red Scepter Shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. You have 5 hours to complete this task.
details: Champion, is it you? A thousand years it has been since I was entrusted the shard and it is at my darkest hour that one should rise to relieve me of it... But what would tragedy be without cruelty?
B<Vaelastrasz coughs weakly.>
BNe... Nefarius now holds the scepter shard.
BTime is of the essence. Nefarius plans to destroy the shard. You must hurry!
completion: Vaelastrasz's soul is at ease, champion. The Aspects all watch your progress with great interest. Know that you have powerful allies.
BI was commanded to grant you something to aid you in this struggle. Use it well...

8754.name: The Path of the Conqueror

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the conqueror!

8778.name: The Ironforge Brigade Needs Explosives!
desc: Bring 6 Oils of Immolation, 5 Goblin Rocket Fuel and 10 Dense Blasting Powder to Arcanist Nozzlespring near Hive'Zora in Silithus. You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing IV in order to complete this quest.

8802.name: The Savior of Kalimdor
desc: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
objectives: Take the Eye of C'Thun to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
details: To the Caverns of Time you go, $G Lord:Lady; $N. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.$B
completion: The Master has left these for you, champion. From the timeless cache: A collection of artifacts spanning thousands of years - the choice is yours.

8874.name: The Lunar Festival
desc: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the entrance to the Undercity. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
details: It's that time of the year, $N! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.
completion: Welcome, $N. Are you here to join in the festivities?

8898.name: Dearest Colara,
desc: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
objectives: Deliver the Creased Letter to Colara Dean outside the bank in Stormwind.
details: I met a lass in Stormwind when I was last there on the bank's business. She stole my heart away. Now, I can't stop thinking about her! I'd like to send her this message - I've rewritten it twelve times!
BThe mail is so full now, and I want to make sure it gets there.
BIf you're heading that way, could you help me?
completion: Tormek? Oh yes, I do remember him. He had quite a nice beard and smile underneath.
BAh, I can't believe he remembered me!

8922.name: A Supernatural Device
desc: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
objectives: Bring the Sealed Blood Container to Mux Manascrambler inside Gadgetzan in Tanaris.
details: I must find a way to speak with Anthion Harmon... or more specifically, his ghost!
BI know of an engineer with a queer interest in the supernatural. He claims he can build a machine that allows him to speak with the dead!
BThe blood you collected was intended for him; travel to Gadgetzan and bring it to him as payment for his services!
completion: Excellent! Just as I was running low!
BYou say Deliana sent you?

8946.name: Proof of Life
desc: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Bring Ysida's Locket to Anthion Harmon in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: It is the cruelest of fates that my beloved has perished while trying to rescue me. Yet, you claim to possess the ability to converse with him.
BBring him this locket as proof that I am well. He must not linger in this world; my heart would not be able to bear it.
BFarewell, $N. I shall be in your debt always.
completion: That locket... you found her! I can rest in peace at long last.
BI shall now answer any questions you might have, $N. But make haste, my time in this world is not long.

8970.name: I See Alcaz Island In Your Future...
desc: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Gather 20 Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga and then return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: As I was saying, $c, in my living years I flirted with becoming a diviner. But, there really wasn't as much profit in it as you might imagine, mostly because it's dangerous and the reagents are rare and expensive. However, I do know enough to be able to pinpoint the final piece of the amulet, and the spirit of my former comrade along with it.
BThis is where you come in, $N. I need you to go to Alcaz Island off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh and collect Bloodkelp from the Strashaz naga that live there.
completion: To be honest, $N, I'm surprised you made it back in one piece. Then again, I guess Alcaz Island is the least of your worries right now.
BOk, give me a moment here... divination isn't something that you can just snap your fingers and expect accurate answers from.

8994.name: Final Preparations
desc: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
objectives: Gather 40 Blackrock Bracers and acquire a Flask of Supreme Power. Return them to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain.
details: We're nearly there, $c. All that is left is to retrieve a few more components so that I can attune the brazier and enable it to beckon forth Lord Valthalak.

BTo begin I must ask you to journey forth into Blackrock Spire and slay the orcs therein. They wear bracers that contain trace metals that I will need, so I'll need more than a few to extract the right amount out of them. Then, to complete the imbuing process, you'll need to bring me a Flask of Supreme Power.
BGood luck, $N!
completion: That's it then. I'll extract the metal from the bracers and imbue the brazier with these final components. Then it will be ready for you to summon Lord Valthalak, and finally return his spirit amulet to him.
BYou've come quite a distance, $N, don't falter now that the end is in sight!

9018.name: Anthion's Parting Words
desc: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
objectives: Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Magister's Boots, Magister's Leggings and Magister's Mantle.
details: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us.

BThe only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for.
BI, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
completion: This curse was bestowed upon us but for a mere medallion. Lord Valthalak certainly knows how to hold a grudge.
BWe'll endeavor to find the remaining pieces - hopefully before I meet an untimely demise. But before that, let us see about your reward.

9042.name: Dreadnaught Bracers
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Bracers if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Bracers, 6 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 1 Nexus Crystal.

9090.name: Dreamwalker Boots
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreamwalker Boots if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 3 Mooncloth and 2 Cured Rugged Hides.

9114.name: Shoulderpads of Faith
desc: Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Shoulderpads of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Shoulderpads, 12 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 2 Mooncloth and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9186.name: Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt
desc: Deliver 9 Wicked Leather Belts and the Craftsman's Writ - Wicked Leather Belt - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9210.name: The Savage Guard - Arcanum of Focus
desc: Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Focus.

9234.name: Icebane Gauntlets
desc: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
objectives: Craftsman Wilhelm at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants 5 Frozen Runes, 12 Thorium Bars, 2 Arcanite Bars, 2 Essences of Water and 200 gold.
details: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icebane gauntlets. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
completion: Here is your order, $N. Delivered as promised!

9330.name: Stealing Stormwind's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
objectives: Return the Flame of Stormwind to the Festival Talespinner.
details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Stormwind itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
completion: And this brightly-burning fire... you say it came from Stormwind? Remarkable! That must have been quite an adventure! I'll pay you for this, of course. If you find anything else like this, be sure to speak with me again.

9378.name: DND FLAG The Dread Citadel - Naxxramas
desc: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
objectives: Archmage Angela Dosantos at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will grant you Arcane Cloaking at no cost. You must be Exalted with the Argent Dawn.
details: In the thick of Plaguewood lies the entrance to the dread citadel of Naxxramas. Previously, all attempts to enter had been stymied by the magical wards placed upon the rune portal. That is, until now.

BWe have devised a way to gain entry via a permanent arcane cloaking of sorts - an old cantrip of the Kirin Tor with a few modifications of my own. With that said, the cloaking is costly; however, your dedication to the cause of the Dawn is unwavering! We will waive all cost associations.
completion: NULL

objectives: Bring 10 Linen Cloth to Tanis Alderwood in the Undercity.
*Linen Cloth (10)
details: Wait, you want to... help? Why would a paladin want to help a beggar like me?
Well, I suppose that you could be of some assistance.

Its my wife you see. She, well... she's falling apart. I mean that literally. The apothecaries can stitch her back together right as rain, but they are about the Dark Lady's business and none are available to help. If you could perhaps bring me some fresh cloth then I could at least make her a wrapping to hold her together while we wait for the apothecaries.

objectives: Collect the Head of the Baron in the Ruins of Lordaeron and bring it back to Captain Truman.
*Head of the Baron
details: What do you want, ? Can't you see there is a war to be won?
My master has already charged into the fray and has ordered me to maintain my post. It has been quite some time, however.

I doubt you'll survive ten minutes in combat, but if it keeps your simple mind busy, why don't you seek out the Grand Marshal. He is the tallest, most statuesque hero you've ever laid eyes on. You'll know him when you see him.

objectives: Slay the Dragonmaw forces within the Excavation Site and return to the Deathstalker Agent outside with anything you recover.
* Dragonmaw Saboteur slain (2)
* Dragonmaw Warder slain (4)
* Dragonmaw Dispatch
details: Dragonmaw.
The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief?
Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected.
If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.

97242.name: Yelmak's Medley
details: Yelmak doesn't want his apprentice breaking anything. Well, anything more than he already has.
He told me the young mixer in training has too much pride to ask for help when he really needs it. Yelmak wants to give him a taste of a particular home-brewed recipe.

Gather a mix of cattail and speargrass cuttings taken from the plants growing around the water in the Valley of Honor. I'd get them myself, but if I left the shop, Whuut would surely know we're catering to his mood.
objectives: Take some cuttings from the Cattails and Speargrass growing around the water flows in the Valley of Honor and return to Kor'geld in Yelmak's Alchemy and Potions.
*Handful of Cattails (2)
*Speargrass Cuttings (4)
completion: This type of cattail and speargrass is unique to Orgrimmar. Drinking from Azshara mountain spring water, and nourished by the sweat and blood soaked mineral dust of our rocky land, these herbs contain potent powers locked within.
I'll give these to Yelmak, who may be able to win back Whuut's ear with a hands-on lesson.

objectives: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.
details: You... abomination...
Why should... help you...
Be gone...
